pictures.name: BF1-Courtyard-Fire
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. Night in the stone courtyard of a high priest’s house in Jerusalem. Servants and guards warming their hands around a small glowing charcoal fire. Among them, Peter, a broad-shouldered fisherman in his thirties with a short dark curly beard and weathered face, in a coarse brown tunic, his face lit orange by the coals, eyes full of fear, turning away from a servant girl who points at him. Deep blue night, cold. A rooster silhouetted on the wall in the background. Shame and fear.

pictures.name: BF3-Shore-At-Dawn
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. Dawn over the Sea of Galilee, mist on the water, pink and gold sky. Seen from the shore: a small fishing boat a hundred yards out, its net suddenly bulging full of silver fish, the fishermen straining. In the water between, Peter, a broad-shouldered fisherman in his thirties with a short dark curly beard and weathered face, in a coarse brown tunic, splashing and wading eagerly toward the shore. In the foreground, Jesus, a man in a plain off-white robe with a soft brown mantle, shown ONLY from behind or as a far figure, his face never visible, stands on the pebbled beach with his back to the viewer. Joy, recognition.

No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. Early morning on the pebbled shore of the Sea of Galilee. pictures.name: BF6-Today
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. A modern setting painted in the same contemplative oil style, warm light, no readable text, no logos. A modern apartment kitchen in the morning. Two adult friends, a little awkward, one has just arrived at the door; the other is setting two plates of breakfast and two coffees on a small table and gesturing warmly for the friend to sit.
